An '''electrum shovel''' is the [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] [[Tools#Shovel|shovel]], made by smithing a [[diamond shovel]] with [[electrum alloy]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template, and enchantments on the diamond item carry over; where both have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Digging ===
It breaks shovel blocks at speed 12 and has 3000 durability. Its Fortune III raises gravel's flint drop.

=== Intrinsics ===
The electrum fortune intrinsic ({{G|Fortune}}) works like [[Fortune]] on ores, crops and leaves; the pack's loot tables check for it directly. Electrum tools are the only source of Fortune III in the pack, and the intrinsic cannot be combined with Fortune or Silk Touch.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/electrum_tool.json}}</ref> Intrinsics are stored on the item and applied as enchantments when it enters a player's inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|6}} damage at an attack speed of 1.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}}. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into an [[adamant alloy]], not electrum, because electrum shares the netherite item IDs. This makes melting electrum gear a way to turn an [[electrum alloy]] into an adamant alloy.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/netherite_ingot_from_blasting_netherite_materials.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[electrum alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/electrum_shovel.json}}</ref>

== Notes ==
* It uses a netherite item ID, so it does not burn in fire or lava.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.03|Electrum alloy now needs a [[divine fragment]].}}
{{History line|1.10|Electrum was buffed. A [[weaponsmith]] now takes the item back in exchange for its alloy, so players can rebuild it with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer takes an ingot in the template slot, and the upgrade keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip. Can only be repaired with blocks of diamond. Electrum became the only source of Fortune III.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|No longer burns in fire or lava. Warding was removed from electrum tools so that they focus on Fortune. Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older copies can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
}}
